Class Db

java.lang.Object
Db
public class Db extends Object
Provides database connections and queries for application data.

    • getSalesTrend

      static ArrayList<String[]> getSalesTrend(String range) throws SQLException
      Retrieves aggregated sales data for a supported reporting period. Each row contains the period timestamp, sales total, and order count as strings.
      Parameters:
      range - the reporting period: "YTD", "TODAY", or "WEEK"
      Returns:
      the sales data points for the requested period
      Throws:
      SQLException - if the database query fails
      IllegalArgumentException - if range is not supported
